'''Amarin''' was an [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] located in the [[Tion Cluster/Legends|Tion Cluster's]] [[Allied Tion sector/Legends|Allied Tion sector]]. By around [[25,130 BBY]], it was ruled by the [[Livien League]] and was the site of a League [[Battle of Amarin|victory]] over the forces of the [[Kingdom of Cron]]. Amarin was later part of the [[Xim's empire|empire]] of [[Cronese]] ruler [[Xim/Legends|Xim]], who expanded and constructed palaces there as well as on [[Argai]] and [[Raxus Prime/Legends|Raxus Prime]]. After Xim's [[Death/Legends|death]], Amarin was part of the [[Jaminere Marches]]. Over [[Time/Legends|time]], it became a busy [[Agriworld/Legends|agriworld]] while also preserving the [[Forest/Legends|forests]] from the world's Xim-era service as a [[Hunting/Legends|hunting]] reserve.

==Description==
Amarin was a [[Planet/Legends|world]]<ref name="Lianna">''[[Mission to Lianna]]''</ref> located in the [[Amarin system/Legends|Amarin system]].<ref name="TEA" /> It was a part of the [[Allied Tion sector/Legends|Allied Tion sector]] of the [[Tion Cluster/Legends|Tion Cluster]],<ref name="Xim" /> situated within [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of<ref name="The Slice" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="TEA" /> The [[Desevran Trace]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] linked it to the [[Corlax system/Legends|Corlax system]] as well as the [[Omman system/Legends|Omman system]] of the [[Tion Hegemony/Legends|Tion Hegemony]] [[Sector/Legends|sector]]. Amarin's surface featured thick, [[Temperature/Legends|cool]] [[Forest/Legends|forests]].<ref name="Xim" />

==History==
[[File:AmarinBattle-TheHistoryOfXimAndTheTionCluster.jpg|thumb|left|300px|Amarin was the site of a Livien League victory over the Kingdom of Cron.]]
Between approximately [[25,150 BBY]]<ref name="Xim" /> and [[25,096 BBY]],<ref name="TEA" /> the Desevran Trace connected Amarin to the [[Kanaver system/Legends|Kanaver system]]; however, the route eventually changed its course and no longer passed through that [[Star system/Legends|system]]. Amarin was part of the [[Tionese (group)/Legends|Tionese]] people's state known as the [[Livien League]] by around [[25,130 BBY]], and it and the world [[Lorrad]] were the sites of [[Battle of Amarin|two]] [[Battle of Lorrad|battles]] where the League's forces defeated [[Fleet/Legends|fleets]] of the [[Kingdom of Cron]], temporarily halting its [[Xer's Campaigns|expansion]] under [[King of Cron|King]] [[Xer VIII]].<ref name="Xim" />

Both the Livien League and Amarin were nevertheless later incorporated into the territory of the [[Cronese]] [[Xim's empire|empire]] of [[Xim/Legends|Xim]],<ref name="TEA" /> Xer's [[Gender/Legends|son]] who had ascended to the [[Throne/Legends|throne]]<ref name="Xim" /> in 25,130 [['ABY-BBY' dating system/Legends|BBY]].<ref name="TEA" /> During his reign, Amarin served as a [[Hunting/Legends|hunting]] reserve, although vast palaces expanded or constructed by Xim there and on the worlds [[Argai]] and [[Raxus Prime/Legends|Raxus Prime]] also served as examples of the mastery of Tionese [[Artisan/Legends|artisans]].<ref name="Xim" />

[[File:XimsEmpireSuccessorStates-XimWeek.jpg|thumb|right|250px|For centuries, Amarin was part of the Jaminere Marches (pictured).]]
For [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]] after Xim's [[Death/Legends|death]] at some point around [[25,100 BBY]], Amarin was under the rule of [[Jaminere Marches]], a state centered on the world [[Jaminere/Legends|Jaminere]]. Over [[Time/Legends|time]], Amarin became one of the most active [[Agriworld/Legends|agriworlds]] of the Tion Cluster, although the world's Xim-era forests were also preserved by tradition, offering a small variation in the [[Star cluster/Legends|cluster's]] otherwise economically stagnant state.<ref name="Xim" /> By the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], Amarin's forests were represented as a faded [[holograph]] at the booths of the [[Orman's Sky Palace]] [[Cantina/Legends|bar]] on the planet [[Lianna/Legends|Lianna]], one of the establishment's several such recreations of sights from the Allied Tion sector worlds.<ref name="Lianna" />

==Behind the scenes==
Amarin was introduced in ''[[Mission to Lianna]]'', a [[1992]] [[West End Games]] ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' adventure authored by [[Joanne E. Wyrick]].<ref name="Lianna" /> The [[December 7]], [[2009]] [[StarWars.com]] [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]]<ref name="XimOriginal">{{SWArchive|url=fans/hyperspace/source/ximweek01/index.html|text=Xim Week: The History of Xim and the Tion Cluster|int=Xim Week: The History of Xim and the Tion Cluster}}</ref> article "[[Xim Week: The History of Xim and the Tion Cluster]]" by [[Jason Fry]] placed it in grid square S-6.<ref name="Xim" />
